title: "Counting Observations"
author: "Catherine A Polik"
date: "2026-10-23"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

Read in data
```{r}
HBR_StrChem <- read.csv(here("Data","HBR_StrChem_1963-2025.csv")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))
glimpse(HBR_StrChem)

HBR_StrDis <- read.csv(here("Data","HBR_StrDis_1956-2024.csv")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(DATE)) %>% select(-DATE)
glimpse(HBR_StrDis)

HBR_PrecChem <- read.csv(here("Data","HBR_PrecChem_1963-2025.csv")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))
glimpse(HBR_PrecChem)

HBR_PrecVol <- read.csv(here("Data","HBR_PrecVol_1956-2026.csv")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(DATE)) %>% select(-DATE)
glimpse(HBR_PrecVol)
```

Summarize
```{r}
HBR_StrChem_summary <- HBR_StrChem %>%
  select(site, date, NO3, NH4, TDN, DON) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(NO3, NH4, TDN, DON), names_to = "analyte", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter_out(is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(site, analyte) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), start = min(date), end = max(date))
```

```{r}
HBR_PrecChem_summary <- HBR_PrecChem %>%
  select(site, date, precipCatch, NO3, NH4, TDN, DON) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(precipCatch, NO3, NH4, TDN, DON), names_to = "analyte", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter_out(is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(site, analyte) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), start = min(date), end = max(date))
```

```{r}
HBR_PrecVol_summary <- HBR_PrecVol %>%
  filter_out(is.na(Precip)) %>%
  group_by(rainGage) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), start = min(date), end = max(date))
```

```{r}
HBR_StrDis_summary <- HBR_StrDis %>%
  filter_out(is.na(Streamflow)) %>%
  group_by(WS) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), start = min(date), end = max(date))
```
